boven.es: arriba; en la planta de arriba

texto: To indicate where a furniture is, position verbs such as «staan» (for standing things) or «liggen» (for flat things) are combined with spatial prepositions: «naast» (next to), «bij» (next to, near), «op» (on), «onder» (below). «Boven» means up or on the top floor, and «beneden» below.

frases.nl: De lamp staat naast het bed.
frases.es: La lámpara está al lado de la cama.
frases.en: The lamp is next to the bed.

frases.nl: In de slaapkamer, bij het raam.
frases.es: En el dormitorio, junto a la ventana.
frases.en: In the bedroom, by the window.

bloques.pregunta: What kind of place does «up» or «on the upper floor» mean in Dutch?

opciones.explicacion: «Boven» indicates the upper or higher position plant, in contrast to «beneden» (below).
It means the opposite: down or on the ground floor.
It means close to horizontal distance, not specifically above.

bloques.pregunta: Where is the lamp placed according to Noor?
bloques.frase: De lamp staat naast het bed.

opciones.explicacion: «Naast het bed» means by the bed or next to it.

opciones.texto: On top of the dining table.
opciones.explicacion: He's not in the dining room, he's in the bedroom by the bed.
The lamp is not stored inside the closet.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the room where the closet is located.

opciones.explicacion: The closet is in the bedroom («de slaapkamer»).
«Badkamer» is the bathroom, located on the top floor.
«Keuken» is the kitchen, not mentioned for the closet.

bloques.pregunta: What particle is added at the end of an affirmative sentence to ask for confirmation («Right?» / «No?»)?

opciones.explicacion: «Toch» works as a question sheet equivalent to «I don't think so.» or «Right?».
«Niet» is the common denial; «toch» is used to ask for confirmation.
«Wel» emphasizes an affirmation against a doubt, does not form the question sheet.

bloques.pregunta: What is Anna trying to check with your question?

opciones.texto: If the bathroom is on the top floor.
opciones.explicacion: «Boven» is located on the top floor and «toch» requests confirmation.

opciones.texto: If the bathroom has an outside window
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't ask for windows in the bathroom, but for its location upstairs.

opciones.texto: If the bathroom lamp works properly
opciones.explicacion: The above-mentioned lamp was next to the bed in the bedroom.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the appropriate position verb for a standing supported lamp.

opciones.explicacion: The objects that are supported on vertical feet govern the verb «staan».
«Liggen» is used for flat-set objects (books, keys).
«Zitten» is used for sitting people or things fit into a hole.

bloques.explicacion: Location question with «waar» and «staat» position verb.

intro: Name the rooms of a house and the position of the main furniture.
